sections.title: 1. Document Information & Governance Baseline
sections.body:
**Document Type:** User Stories Specification (Agile Backlog)
**Project Title:** hii
**Specification Version:** v1.0
**Document Status:** PENDING APPROVAL
**Authoring Engine:** REFYNE AI Requirement Engineering Pipeline

This specification defines the decomposed, verifiable user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirement traceability matrix for **hii**. All stories are grounded in the source requirements.

sections.title: 2. Source Requirement Summary & Scope Baseline
sections.body:
The source specification establishes a centralized operational platform covering comprehensive clinical, diagnostic, pharmaceutical, financial, and administrative capabilities.

**Key Scope Areas Extracted from Source:**
• **REQ-01 (Identity & Access)**: User Authentication & Authorization — *Secure user registration, authentication, and role-based access control.*
• **REQ-02 (Core Operations)**: Primary Transaction Processing — *Execution and state tracking of the system's core operational workflow.*
• **REQ-03 (Data Management)**: Entity Lifecycle & History — *CRUD operations, audit trails, and status histories for primary business entities.*
• **REQ-04 (Reporting & Analytics)**: Dashboards & Operational Reporting — *Summary reporting, search/filtering, and management metrics.*
• **REQ-05 (System Governance)**: Auditability, Backups & Reliability — *Input validation, automated error logging, and disaster recovery backups.*

sections.title: 3. Authorized System Personas & Role Mappings
sections.body:
The system enforces role-based access for the following authorized personas explicitly identified in the source requirements:

• **Admin**: System configuration, user administration, security policy, and operational oversight.
• **Operations User**: Day-to-day workflow execution, transaction processing, and status management.
• **End User / Customer**: Self-service requests, profile management, and viewing transaction status.

sections.title: 6. End-to-End Workflow Coverage
sections.body:
The user stories fully encompass the complete multi-step workflows defined in the source document:

**Primary Operational Workflow:**
`User Authentication → Entity Ingestion / Request → Validation & Processing → Status Updates → Audit & Verification`

sections.title: 7. Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)
sections.body: This matrix provides 100% bidirectional traceability from original source requirements to executable user stories.

sections.title: 8. Dependency-Derived Release & Sprint Slicing
sections.body:
**Release 1: Outpatient Care, Doctor Availability & Core EMR Foundation**
• **Objective:** Establish patient onboarding, front-desk scheduling, OPD queues, vital signs, allergies, and core doctor notes.
• **User Stories:** 

**Release 2: Inpatient (IPD) Lifecycle, Diagnostic Lab & Pharmacy Operations**
• **Objective:** Deploy inpatient admission-to-discharge, bed allocations, transfers, lab ordering/results, and pharmacy stock decrements.
• **User Stories:** 

**Release 3: Financials, Expenses, Hospital Administration & Governance**
• **Objective:** Complete billing reconciliation, insurance claims, expenses, staff management, general procurement, and audit logs.
• **User Stories:** US-01, US-02, US-03, US-04, US-05

sections.title: 9. Technical Dependencies & Cross-Module Constraints
sections.body:
• **Authentication Gate:** User authentication and role-based access control (US-ADM-03) must be established prior to granting role-specific access.
• **Clinical Data Flow:** Prescription and lab orders require an active consultation encounter or inpatient admission record.
• **Financial Invoicing:** Inpatient final billing requires completed discharge clearance from the attending doctor.
• **Inventory Deductions:** Medicine dispensing strictly validates on-hand batch quantities before decrementing stock.

sections.title: 10. Open Items & Stakeholder Clarifications
sections.body:
• **Third-Party Payment Gateway Providers:** Identify specific payment gateway vendors (e.g. Stripe, Razorpay) for digital payment processing.
• **External Insurance Clearinghouses:** Determine whether EDI/electronic insurance claim clearinghouse integration is required in subsequent phases.
• **Hardware Barcode Scanners:** Confirm barcode/QR scanner device protocols for pharmacy inventory batch scanning.
